title: Kubernetes CI/CD
note: A Kubernetes-native CI/CD system built from scratch. A push becomes a PipelineRun custom resource; an operator reads the pipeline file, turns it into a dependency graph, and runs every step as its own Pod, independent steps in parallel. The operator keeps no state, so it survives being killed mid-run. Four parallel jobs finished 2.9x faster than the same four in a chain.

title: ACID Lakehouse
note: A Delta-Lake-style table format built from scratch. Every commit is one file in a transaction log, and writers race to create it; the loser checks what the winner changed and retries unless it touched data it had read. Eight threads doing read-modify-write on one table lost no updates. Per-file min/max stats from Parquet footers let Spark skip files: a range query read 1 of 10.
